title: SmartNIC-Based Distributed Shared Memory
problem: Maintaining memory coherence and enabling efficient data sharing across heterogeneous computing systems that mix x86 and ARM processors with SmartNICs and other smart I/O devices. Current architectures lack a unified mechanism for distributed shared memory in these ISA-heterogeneous environments.
motivation: Data center providers increasingly deploy heterogeneous hardware including ARM-based systems alongside x86, requiring efficient memory coherence mechanisms to support unified application execution.
method: Leverages SmartNICs embedded with full-featured SoCs to implement a distributed shared memory layer that bridges heterogeneous ISA endpoints. Uses the SmartNIC's processing capabilities to manage memory coherence protocol enforcement and remote memory access requests across the heterogeneous fabric, eliminating the need for centralized coherence management.
key_novelty: Using SmartNICs as coherence controllers to enable distributed shared memory abstractions in ISA-heterogeneous computing environments.
contributions: SmartNIC-based memory coherence protocol for heterogeneous ISA systems
Mechanism for efficient remote memory access across ARM and x86 nodes
Demonstration of distributed shared memory on SmartNIC-equipped data center fabric
primary_theme: SmartNIC-based memory coherence for heterogeneous systems
